name: Ariel JGN / JGQ separable reciprocating compressor (1-throw and 2-throw)
description: Materials as printed: gray iron crankcase, forged steel crankshaft, gray iron crosshead guide, tri-metal main bearing, ductile iron crosshead, alloy steel crosshead pin, forged steel connecting rod with bronze pin bushing and grade 8 stress bolts. Linked JGNQ product spec sheet is a PDF (not read). Primary source: https://www.arielcorp.com/compressors/compressor-landing-page/jgn-jgq.html
